title: Fleet Account Tenure Addition to the Early-Payment Discount Rate — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders fleet invoice, the tenure addition follows how long the account has been open and the terms:

| Whole months from the account's opening date to the payment date | Account | Added to the discount rate |
|---|---|---|
| 60 or more | Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | 0.5% |
| 60 or more | Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | 0.25% |
| Fewer than 60 | — | nothing |

The payment date is the date of the latest payment received on the invoice. A whole month is complete on the same day of a later month, or on the first day of the month after it where that month has no such day.

**Edges (hypothetical dates).** Account opened 22 June: an invoice whose latest payment is dated 22 June five years later counts 60 whole months; one paid 21 June of that year counts 59.
